DEL Standings

Source: R/esports.R
del_standings.Rd

Standings of one competition season, one row per team.

Wraps GET https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/de.hokejovyzapis.cz/tables/{season}/{league_id}.json of the DEL eSports bucket. Example: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/de.hokejovyzapis.cz/tables/2026/1.json. Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/27); every request waits at least one second after the last one to the same host.

Usage

del_standings(season, league_id = 1L, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

season

Season by its END year (2027 = 2026/27). The bucket keys seasons by their START year; the wrapper requests season - 1.

league_id

Competition id. 1 = DEL regular season, 3 = DEL playoffs (also 2 = Test-Liga pre-season, 4 = MagentaSport Cup 2020/21, 5 = NHL Global Series 2022/23).

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON body (a nested list).

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per row of the file (zero rows, carrying the documented columns, for an empty frame); the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE. Columns:

col_nametypedescription
league_part_idintegerLeague part id (league-part key space, per bucket: one stage of a competition, e.g. ICEHL 56 = 2026/27 regular season); joins to league_part_id in league-matches and the {league_part_id} path param.
league_part_namecharacterLeague part name, e.g. DEL 2026/27.
statecharacterStandings state flag (e.g. live or final; values unverified).
datetimecharacterStandings computed at, local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
team_idintegerTeam id (per-bucket team key space); joins to home_id / guest_id in the schedule.
part_team_idintegerTeam-in-league-part id (its own key space: one team in one league part); no other captured file carries it.
namecharacterTeam display name.
shortcutcharacterThree-letter team code.
positionintegerTable position, 1 = first.
pointsintegerTable points.
gamesintegerGames played.
winsintegerWins in regulation (DEL, EIHL, Denmark) or all wins (ICEHL, see winsReg); definition per bucket unverified.
wins_otintegerWins after overtime or shootout.
tiesintegerTies (0 under current rules).
losses_otintegerLosses after overtime or shootout.
lossesintegerLosses in regulation time.
score1integerGoals the team scored (goals for).
score2integerGoals against.
only_so_winsintegerWins in a shootout.
only_so_lostsintegerLosses in a shootout.
only_ot_winsintegerWins in overtime.
only_ot_lostsintegerLosses in overtime.
bonusintegerBonus or deduction points (DEL).
ppgnumericPoints per game.

Errors

Signalled as classed conditions: fastRhockey_no_data when the bucket has no such key (S3 404 NoSuchKey: unknown season, competition, match or team) or the file holds no rows (an unplayed game, an empty shot shell); fastRhockey_asset_fetch for any other non-2xx answer (403 AccessDenied), a connection failure after retries, an empty or unreadable 200 body, an error envelope, a body of the wrong shape, or a body for another season or game; fastRhockey_bad_request for an HTTP 400/422 or an invalid argument. All three also inherit fastRhockey_error. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

DEL (the league site whose widgets read this public eSports bucket)

Other DEL eSports functions: del_faceoffs(), del_game_info(), del_goalie_box(), del_pbp(), del_player_box(), del_roster(), del_schedule(), del_shifts(), del_shots(), del_team_player_stats(), del_top_scorers()
